excerpt: Shall the City of Lebo, Kansas, be authorized to impose a one percent (1%) City-wide retailers' sales tax (the "Sales Tax"), which shall constitute a general purpose sales tax, with the revenues derived therefrom to be used for public infrastructure improvements, capital improvement projects, public facilities, utility improvements, street improvements, parks and recreation improvements, and payment of any bonds issued therefor, with collection of the Sales Tax to commence on April 1, 2027, or as soon thereafter as permitted by law?

whatItDoes: Shall the City of Lebo, Kansas, be authorized to impose a one percent (1%) City-wide retailers' sales tax (the "Sales Tax"), which shall constitute a general purpose sales tax, with the revenues derived therefrom to be used for public infrastructure improvements, capital improvement projects, public facilities, utility improvements, street improvements, parks and recreation improvements, and payment of any bonds issued therefor, with collection of the Sales Tax to commence on April 1, 2027, or as soon thereafter as permitted by law?

General. The following additional information is provided by the City with respect to the impact of this ballot question. Passage of this ballot proposition would authorize the City to impose a one percent (1%) City-wide retailers’ sales tax (the “Sales Tax”) the proceeds of which shall be used to finance the purposes described therein. Collection of the Sales Tax, if approved by the electors of the City, shall commence April 1, 2027, or as soon thereafter as permitted by the Act, and shall not terminate until repealed by ordinance of the City.
